viewing_check: Check the striking dolly/insert for Star posts is in the box (and the MaxY insert if any), the trigger valve and handles are intact, no cracked barrel or dented sleeve, the air fitting and hose are not perished, and the manual or parts bag is there. Ask if it has been run (oil in the inlet is a good sign). Missing dolly or inserts cut value by A$100+.
